status: Sample host ledger at revision 42 with six members (the host holds scorer and capture-controller) and six recording cameras; each submit names the authenticated channel peer

cases.why: An identical retry returns the original receipt; one event
Reusing an id with different contents is rejected and security-logged; the original stands
D4: a retry that recomputes ageAtSendMs is the same command (the fingerprint excludes it), not an attack
Two writes against revision 42: one update, one visible conflict
Undo is an event naming its target; totals are recomputed from the log
Pairing or claiming does not grant a role
D1: the issuer must be the authenticated channel peer; a body claiming another member, device or watch is refused and logged
D10: a non-member cannot burn a member's commandId; ids are scoped to the authenticated member
D10: a command for the next epoch is refused but not burned; after host recovery at that epoch the same bytes apply
Grants are a set: the host scores and controls capture; a role it does not hold is refused
A watch never issues capture requests, even for a capture-controller (ADR-0026 as amended)
Marks are source-linked notes with receipts; they never move the score revision
Start is a request: permission and foreground decide on each phone; no fictitious Recording
D13: a device still finalizing its previous take denies a start and never reports Starting
A room-wide stop is a fan-out with individual results; no blanket success
D12: a capture request with nothing to target is refused, never an Accepted receipt with no results
Stop one names one target and touches only it
Capture requests expire on unbounded or excessive age; score commands rely on the revision instead
D5: a missing, partial or negative transit observation is unbounded transit; it can never extend a TTL
Commands bound to another session or epoch are refused
After process death (or a fold/rotation recreation) an identical retry still applies once
Disconnect never stops cameras
